title: ClimateGuard AI - Home
prompt:
Design PAGE 1: HOME / LANDING PAGE for ClimateGuard AI.
Follow exact user prompt specifications for enterprise dark aesthetic:
- SECTION A — HERO:
  Large heading: "Predict Climate Risks Before They Become Disasters."
  Subtitle: "AI-powered climate intelligence and automated disaster finance to help communities prepare, respond and recover faster."
  Primary CTA: "Explore Live Dashboard", Secondary CTA: "Discover How It Works"
  Hero visual: A large realistic satellite-style dark Earth geospatial view with highlighted climate risk regions in cyan (#22D3EE), amber (#EAB308), and red (#EF4444). Subtle climate data grid, location pins (e.g. Mekong Delta, Zambezi Basin, Indus Valley), floating telemetry cards showing live barometer, precipitation anomalies, and parametric readiness scores.
- SECTION B — LIVE CLIMATE OVERVIEW:
  5 live telemetry KPI cards: Active Risk Zones (14 Monitored Basins), Monitored Locations (1,280km²), Flood Risk (Elevated 74%), Heatwave Risk (Severe 42.8°C), Drought Risk (Critical -38% soil moisture). All with realistic, real-world ready data visual components.
- SECTION C — THE PROBLEM:
  Heading: "Disasters Should Not Catch Communities Unprepared."
  4 feature cards: Delayed disaster response, Inaccurate local risk awareness, Financial relief bottlenecks, Fragmented climate observation silos.
- SECTION D — OUR SOLUTION:
  4 pillars: Predictive climate intelligence, Geospatial telemetry, Financial trigger automation, Lightweight edge inference.
- SECTION E — HOW IT WORKS:
  Visual horizontal pipeline with step indicators & connecting lines:
  Climate Data → Risk Analysis → Geospatial Intelligence → Financial Trigger → Emergency Funding Recommendation.
- SECTION F — CLIMATE HAZARDS:
  3 comprehensive cards:
  1. Flood Monitoring (River discharge, Rainfall mm/24h, Flood risk assessment index)
  2. Heatwave Monitoring (Wet-bulb temperature, Humidity index, Heat vulnerability exposure)
  3. Drought Monitoring (Rainfall deficit anomaly, Root-zone soil moisture, Crop stress metrics).
- SECTION G — GEOSPATIAL PREVIEW:
  Interactive high-density risk map preview with multi-hazard layers, satellite toggles, location pins, and a full risk severity legend (Safe/Low #22C55E, Moderate #EAB308, High #F97316, Critical #EF4444).
- SECTION H — DISASTER FINANCE:
  Explain parametric insurance simulation and emergency funding recommendations.
- SECTION I — C01 PERFORMANCE:
  Lightweight edge inference architecture callout: 100 inferences under 200 ms, Operational memory under 256 MB. Stated clearly as verifiable requirements.
- SECTION J — FINAL CTA:
  Heading: "Build Climate Resilience Before the Next Disaster." Button: "Launch ClimateGuard".
